back: The exchange of information, ideas or instructions between a sender and a receiver so that the message is understood.
Sender, message, medium, receiver, feedback; effective only if the receiver understands.
The receiver's response, showing whether the message has been understood.
Fast, personal, immediate feedback; but no record unless noted and hard to reach many people.
Permanent record and precise; but slower and no immediate feedback.
Fast, cheap to many, records kept; but needs equipment and network, overload and security risks.
Quick to understand and good for numbers and instructions; limited detail and may be misread.
Consider purpose, audience, urgency, need for a record, complexity, cost and confidentiality.
Memo (internal), letter (external), email, statement (account summary) and invoice (bill with goods, prices, total and terms).
